summary: Iteration 4 retest + deferred iteration 3 backend suite. ALL 3 iter4 bugs verified FIXED. iter4 suite: 22/22 PASS (was 16/22). iter3 suite: 40/40 PASS. New retest suite (43 tests) covering extra geo coords, region round-trip, admin auth enforcement, ads CRUD, pages editor, real YouTube RSS sync, contact PUT preservation: 42/43 PASS. Only failure: /api/news?region=national does NOT filter out regional articles — this contradicts explicit review-request behavior. Frontend regression: homepage renders with red/blue theme, region banner + shorts rail visible, all 9 admin tabs (articles/categories/ads/livetv/youtube/flash/theme/pages/contact) open cleanly, all data-testids present.

minor.issue: When region=national is passed, backend applies NO region filter (see server.py line 292: `if region and region != 'national' and region != 'all'`) and returns ALL articles including karnataka/tamil_nadu/etc. Review request explicitly says it should return only region='national' + region-missing legacy items. Effect: on National view, users see regional Karnataka/AP/TN content that should be hidden.
minor.fix: Change condition to `if region and region != 'all':` and treat 'national' as: `query['$or'] = [{'region': 'national'}, {'region': {'$exists': False}}]`. Keep the existing branch for non-national/non-all regions.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in YoutubeTab select for category (dev overlay injects data-ve-dynamic span into <option>). Does not affect users in production but produces console noise in dev.

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix /api/news?region=national to explicitly filter to {region: 'national'} OR {region missing} so the National view doesn't leak regional articles.
LOW: YoutubeTab option innerHTML — wrap {c.name_te} in a plain text expression to avoid dev-mode <span> hydration warning inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 760 lines — approaching but not yet critical; consider splitting into routers (news, settings, admin, widgets, geo) before adding more.

list_news region handling: the current `if region != 'national'` short-circuit is the source of the new bug. Recommend removing the special-case and letting 'national' explicitly filter to {'$or': [{region:'national'},{region:{'$exists':False}}]}.
detect_region best-fit is elegant but O(N) — fine for 5 regions; if scaling to districts consider R-tree. Also consider point-in-polygon for accuracy at coastal boundaries.
get_setting default-merge is now correct. However, DEFAULT_SETTINGS is duplicated in seed_defaults() startup logic; consider single source of truth constant.
Ads endpoint DELETE returns generic {success: true}; consider returning 204 No Content per REST convention.

region_national_filter_leak.root_cause: server.py list_news() line 292: `if region and region != 'national' and region != 'all': query['$or'] = [...]`. When region=='national', this branch is skipped, no filter applied → returns everything.
region_national_filter_leak.reproduction: curl 'https://.../api/news?region=national&limit=200' → returns karnataka & tamil_nadu articles in results.
region_national_filter_leak.expected: Return only articles where region=='national' OR region field missing (legacy).
